verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same banner. In each, the headline 'Garden-fresh fizz' breaks so that 'fizz' sits alone on a second line, the can is shrunk to a speck, and the legal text is squeezed into an unreadable 3-line block under the CTA. B edges ahead because its larger, heavier headline gives a slightly clearer hierarchy, while A's thinner headline competes with the CTA and legal text.
